text: Spot the number here that isn't a perfect square: 9, 16, 25, 36, 48, 64.
why: The others are square numbers (3×3 up to 8×8); 48 isn't.

text: I'm a three-digit number. My digits add up to 2, and I'm odd. What am I?
why: Only 101, 110 and 200 have digits adding to 2, and only 101 is odd.
